entries.summary: Independent MIT audit correction: course-level assessment scope, institutional tools and data restrictions, recommendation versus requirement, and a student summary held for renewed review.

Independent Imperial audit correction: institutional dAIsy model access, assessment disclosure, Copilot retention and search conditions, 2026–27 detector guidance, scoped misconduct appeals, and a student summary held for renewed review.

Stanford combines BCA guidance with distinct GSB, Law, MD/MSPA and PWR rules. GSB MBA/MSx take-home AI use cannot be banned by instructors; in-class rules differ. Institutional tool access is separate from assessment and clinical permission.

Oxford requires assessment-specific AI instructions and declarations. MPLS research-student rules have a divisional scope. Research policy distinguishes should declare from conditional must. Some security/tool guidance has migrated; access is not assessment permission.
